description.zh: 自动续费ECS实例列表。RenewAllInstances不为true时生效。
description.en: The list of ECS instances for which to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect only when RenewAllInstances is not set to true.

description.zh:
集群是否开启自动续费。取值范围：

- true：开启自动续费。

- false：不开启自动续费。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the cluster. Valid values:

- true: Enables auto-renewal.

- false: Disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
集群自动续费时长。当 ClusterAutoRenew 取值为 true 时生效。
ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit取值为 Month 时，取值：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36。ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit取值为 Year时，取值：1、2、3。
description.en:
The auto-renewal duration for the cluster. This parameter takes effect only when ClusterAutoRenew is set to true.
If ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit is set to Month, the valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, and 36. If ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit is set to Year, the valid values are 1, 2, and 3.

description.zh:
集群续费时长单位。取值范围：

- Month：月。

- Year：年。

默认值：Month。
description.en:
The unit of the auto-renewal duration. Valid values:

- Month

- Year

Default value: Month.

description.zh:
是否对集群中所有ECS实例配置自动续费。取值范围：

- true：对集群中所有ECS实例配置自动续费，默认配置自动续费1个月。

- false：不对集群中所有ECS实例配置自动续费。可在AutoRenewInstances中指定要配置自动续费的ECS实例。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for all ECS instances in the cluster. Valid values:

- true: Enables auto-renewal for all ECS instances in the cluster. The default auto-renewal duration is one month.

- false: Does not enable auto-renewal for all ECS instances in the cluster. You can specify the ECS instances for which to enable auto-renewal in the AutoRenewInstances parameter.

Default value: false.

title.zh: 修改集群的自动续费属性

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解E-MapReduce产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.d54d281ftXTbvg#/emapreduce/detail/emrpre)。注意：自动续费不等于立即续费，若您的实例已经到期或将于明天到期，请先手动续费。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, make sure you understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.d54d281ftXTbvg#/emapreduce/detail/emrpre) of E-MapReduce. Note: Auto-renewal is different from manual renewal. If an instance has expired or will expire the next day, you must perform a manual renewal first.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr update-cluster-auto-renew --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-d6661c71139a0000 --cluster-auto-renew true --cluster-auto-renew-duration 1 --cluster-auto-renew-duration-unit Monthly --renew-all-instances true --auto-renew-instances example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr UpdateClusterAutoRenew --region cn-hangzhou --AutoRenewInstances.1 'example-string' --ClusterAutoRenewDuration 1 --ClusterAutoRenewDurationUnit Monthly --ClusterId 'c-d6661c71139a0000' --ClusterAutoRenew true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RenewAllInstances true --method POST --force
